title: Lane-lint accepts a touched-tests run when the later delta touches no test
why: A doc-only push (head 226c97c26 on 4408c76c9, PR #2932) started no lane-touched-tests job. Lane-lint then reads the run as 'unknown' and refuses, though the parent head's touched run passed and the delta touches no test file. The only way past is --lint-unknown-ok, which the auto-mode classifier refuses. Every doc-only fix after a main merge hits this (since #3121, step batch-build-reads-draft-runs).
note: Fix: when the delta from the last head with a touched-tests run touches no test file (the touched-tests workflow's own path filter, one home), lint accepts that run and names it. Red first: a doc-only head after a passing touched run lints PASS; a head that touches a test with no run still reads unknown. Check change: full review, net-value test after round 3.
